subject: Re: Aeroworks - on-site demo timing and coverage
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Zhao <lucy@aeroworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aeroworks on-site demo — proposed 24 July

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our last conversation, we were planning an on-site demo at Aeroworks HQ for Thursday, July 24 at 10:00 AM PT. Marissa (SE) would lead the technical walkthrough and I (AE) will cover the business outcomes and rollout plan.

Heads-up: Marissa flagged travel that morning (early flight) and asked whether we can either (A) move the technical deep-dive slightly later in the week, or (B) split the session: 30-min exec summary on 7/24 and a longer technical session on another day when Marissa is fully available.

Attached is a short agenda so we can carve time for exec stakeholders vs. the hands-on demo. If the execs prefer a short summary first, we can run 30 minutes on-site and follow up with a remote deep-dive the following week.

Proposed options:
- Option 1: Keep 7/24 10:00 AM PT as an on-site 30-min exec summary (Marissa dial-in at ~11:30 PT after travel) + remote deep-dive July 29 (1 hr)
- Option 2: Reschedule full on-site to July 28 (no travel clash)

Can you confirm what works best for Lucy and Paul? If neither, please share two windows and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —
Sergio

—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Aeroworks-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)
From: Lucy Zhao <lucy@aeroworks.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Turner <paul.turner@aeroworks.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aeroworks on-site demo — proposed 24 July

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the agenda. Unfortunately we’ve just had an executive calendar shift — our VP of Ops has a board prep meeting that morning and is double-booked through the afternoon.

Would you be able to:
1) Run a 25–30 minute executive summary on-site on 7/24 with a couple of our leads (no deep technical run) and schedule the technical deep-dive for the following week; or
2) Move the full session to Tuesday, July 29 (Paul can make that day).

If option 1 is possible, we’ll still want Marissa on the remote walkthrough for the tech portion. Please confirm availability and we’ll lock a time.

Best,
Lucy

Lucy Zhao
Director, Product Strategy | Aeroworks Systems
lucy@aeroworks.com | +1 (617) 555-4444
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucy Zhao <lucy@aeroworks.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aeroworks on-site demo — exec double-booked (plan proposal)

Marissa / Karthik —

Lucy just confirmed the VP is double-booked on 7/24. Two options on the table from the customer: short 25–30 min exec summary on 7/24 (on-site) + remote technical deep-dive the week after, or move the full session to 7/29.

Marissa, you mentioned travel that morning — can you confirm if you can join the 7/24 exec slot remotely (phone/meet) and then run the 1-hr deep-dive remotely on July 29? If not, we’ll propose the full move to 7/29 and I can adjust the travel.

If we go with split sessions I’ll:
- Send a 7/24 invite for exec summary (30 min) to Lucy / Paul / their leads
- Book a remote 1-hr deep-dive for 7/29 10:00 AM PT and include architecture doc + prod screenshot pack

Please reply with availability. Need to confirm to Lucy by EOD so they can coordinate internal invitees.

—
Sergio
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lucy Zhao <lucy@aeroworks.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aeroworks on-site demo — exec double-booked (plan proposal)

Thanks for flagging — I can make the 7/24 30-min exec summary remote (I'll be on an early flight but can dial in by phone or Meet at 10:00 AM PT). I can lead the technical deep-dive on Tues, 7/29 at 10:00 AM PT (remote) — that slot works for me.

Sergio: please send the two invites (7/24 exec summary on-site + 7/29 remote deep-dive). I’ve attached the updated architecture slide I plan to share in the tech session.

Lucy: looking forward to it — happy to tailor the deep-dive to the integration questions you flagged.

—
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0234
